sentences.en: You know, but I don't think like that this time.
sentences.zh: 你知道，但这次我不会那样想了。

sentences.en: I'm trying to, like you said, just keep pushing it and we'll be okay, you know.
sentences.zh: 我正在努力，就像你说的，坚持下去，我们会没事的，你知道。

sentences.en: And so what happens with this birth?
sentences.zh: 那么这次生产发生了什么？

sentences.en: So, well, the doctor said, we're afraid of you having a post-term baby because this baby wasn't, we thought the baby would be coming earlier, but he wasn't.
sentences.zh: 嗯，医生说，我们担心你会过期妊娠，因为这个孩子，我们原以为他会早点出来，但他没有。

sentences.en: And so we're kind of nervous.
sentences.zh: 所以我们有点紧张。

sentences.en: We're thinking that by Thursday we're going to induce him.
sentences.zh: 我们打算周四给他进行引产。

sentences.en: So this was Monday.
sentences.zh: 所以这是周一的事。

sentences.en: In other words, the pregnancy is running a little bit late.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，怀孕时间稍微有点长了。

sentences.en: It was a little bit late.
sentences.zh: 确实稍微晚了一点。

sentences.en: So we went to the doctor on Monday and she was just getting the usual test, just seeing how the baby was.
sentences.zh: 所以我们周一去了医生那里，她只是在做常规检查，看看孩子的情况。

sentences.en: And it seemed like the baby wasn't doing so well.
sentences.zh: 看起来孩子的情况不太好。

sentences.en: His little heart was going, it didn't look normal on the screen.
sentences.zh: 他的小心脏跳动着，在屏幕上看起来不太正常。

sentences.en: And so the woman who was reading the monitor said, I need to call your doctor right away.
sentences.zh: 于是负责看监护仪的那位女士说，我得马上叫你的医生。

sentences.en: I think we're going to have to take this baby out now.
sentences.zh: 我想我们现在必须把孩子取出来了。

sentences.en: She's having the baby today.
sentences.zh: 她今天就要生了。

sentences.en: So she got in her room and they started giving her the Pitocin, a medication that induces labor.
sentences.zh: 所以她进了病房，他们开始给她注射催产素，这是一种诱导分娩的药物。

sentences.en: And then about five hours in, the pain got pretty bad.
sentences.zh: 大约五小时后，疼痛变得非常剧烈。

sentences.en: So she needed an epidural.
sentences.zh: 所以她需要无痛分娩。

sentences.en: So Latona, Dula and I had to step out of the room.
sentences.zh: 于是导乐拉托娜（Latona）和我不得不走出房间。

sentences.en: When we came back, Simone was not in a good way.
sentences.zh: 当我们回来时，西蒙妮的情况很不妙。

sentences.en: She was very upset.
sentences.zh: 她非常难受。

sentences.en: She was clenching her fists.
sentences.zh: 她紧紧攥着拳头。

sentences.en: She was very angry.
sentences.zh: 她非常愤怒。

sentences.en: And this epidural, of course, is supposed to make things better.
sentences.zh: 当然，这种无痛分娩本应让情况好转。

sentences.en: Better.
sentences.zh: 好转。

sentences.en: But they gave her an epidural that was more like if you needed a C-section, not just the regular epidural, just to alleviate the pain of labor.
sentences.zh: 但他们给她用的无痛分娩剂量更像是剖腹产用的，而不是仅仅为了减轻分娩疼痛的常规剂量。

sentences.en: So it was too much?
sentences.zh: 所以剂量太大了？

sentences.en: It was too much.
sentences.zh: 太大了。

sentences.en: And so Simone was really angry because she couldn't feel her legs, which is not how it's supposed to be in this kind of epidural.
sentences.zh: 所以西蒙妮非常生气，因为她感觉不到自己的腿了，而这种无痛分娩本不该是这样的。

sentences.en: But also we saw her blood pressure going up and we saw the baby's heart rate kind of moving all over the place.
sentences.zh: 而且我们还看到她的血压在升高，孩子的胎心率也波动得很厉害。

sentences.en: So Latona, she said, we've got to get Simone calmed down.
sentences.zh: 于是拉托娜说，我们得让西蒙妮冷静下来。

sentences.en: And so Latona was very smooth.
sentences.zh: 拉托娜非常从容。

sentences.en: She started massaging her hands and she started saying, we just need to, something terrible has happened.
sentences.zh: 她开始按摩她的手，并开始说，我们只需要，发生了可怕的事情。

sentences.en: It wasn't right.
sentences.zh: 这不对劲。

sentences.en: And she had the medical personnel come and explain.
sentences.zh: 她叫来了医务人员进行解释。

sentences.en: And actually they said, we're sorry.
sentences.zh: 事实上他们说，我们很抱歉。

sentences.en: They had actually given her the wrong dose.
sentences.zh: 他们确实给她用了错误的剂量。

sentences.en: They had given her the wrong dose.
sentences.zh: 他们给她用了错误的剂量。

sentences.en: She was right.
sentences.zh: 她是正确的。

sentences.en: So then about 1am, it's time.
sentences.zh: 然后大约凌晨1点，时间到了。

sentences.en: And so a whole bunch of residents come in.
sentences.zh: 一大群住院医生走了进来。

sentences.en: And then this man who I'd never seen before, Simone had never seen before.
sentences.zh: 然后这个我从未见过，西蒙妮也从未见过的男人出现了。

sentences.en: And he said, oh, I'm Dr. So-and-so.
sentences.zh: 他说，哦，我是某某医生。

sentences.en: I'm going to deliver your baby.
sentences.zh: 我要为你接生。

sentences.en: It was like, who is this?
sentences.zh: 当时的感觉就是，这是谁？

sentences.en: Who is this man?
sentences.zh: 这个男人是谁？

sentences.en: So it turns out that Black women are much more likely than white women to meet the provider who's going to deliver their baby for the first time during labor and childbirth.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，黑人女性比白人女性更有可能在分娩时才第一次见到为她们接生的医生。

sentences.en: Which is its own form of stress.
sentences.zh: 这本身就是一种压力。

sentences.en: Which was really stressful.
sentences.zh: 这真的压力很大。

sentences.en: But Simone was way beyond that.
sentences.zh: 但西蒙妮已经顾不上这些了。

sentences.en: She was like, just get this baby out of me.
sentences.zh: 她当时想的是，快把这孩子从我身体里取出来。

sentences.en: And then finally, Simone was just in the zone and she was pushing and Latona was at her side saying, push, you can do this.
sentences.zh: 最后，西蒙妮进入了状态，她开始用力，拉托娜在她身边说，用力，你能做到的。

sentences.en: You've got this.
sentences.zh: 你行的。

sentences.en: And I was even doing it too.
sentences.zh: 我也在跟着一起做。

sentences.en: Simone pushed the baby out and the baby came out and he was very still.
sentences.zh: 西蒙妮把孩子生了出来，孩子出来了，但他非常安静。

sentences.en: So they put the baby on her chest and I was holding my breath.
sentences.zh: 他们把孩子放在她胸口，我屏住了呼吸。

sentences.en: And Simone said, is he okay?
sentences.zh: 西蒙妮说，他没事吧？

sentences.en: Is everything okay?
sentences.zh: 一切都好吗？

sentences.en: And then all of a sudden, he lets out this wail and we knew he was okay.
sentences.zh: 突然间，他发出了一声啼哭，我们知道他没事了。

sentences.en: And how did Simone seem in this moment when she's finally holding this newborn?
sentences.zh: 当西蒙妮终于抱住这个新生儿时，她看起来怎么样？

sentences.en: It was everything.
sentences.zh: 那是一切。

sentences.en: I've never seen somebody have so many emotions at once.
sentences.zh: 我从未见过一个人能同时拥有如此多的情绪。

sentences.en: She was crying.
sentences.zh: 她在哭。

sentences.en: She was gasping.
sentences.zh: 她在喘息。

sentences.en: She was happy.
sentences.zh: 她很开心。

sentences.en: She was laughing.
sentences.zh: 她在笑。

sentences.en: Everything.
sentences.zh: 所有的一切。

sentences.en: It was all this pileup of emotions because she survived.
sentences.zh: 那是所有情绪的堆积，因为她活下来了。

sentences.en: And she has this baby and she made it.
sentences.zh: 她有了这个孩子，她挺过来了。

sentences.en: And she named the baby Kingston and his middle name is Blessed.
sentences.zh: 她给孩子取名金斯顿（Kingston），中间名是布莱斯德（Blessed）。

sentences.en: It's kind of remarkable to understand after everything that you've told us here that what we're seeing here
sentences.zh: 在听了你在这里讲述的一切之后，理解到我们所看到的这一切是相当了不起的

sentences.en: that's simply surviving pregnancy, mother and son, that that is a triumph.
sentences.zh: 仅仅是母子平安地度过怀孕期，这本身就是一种胜利。

sentences.en: That that is against, in some ways, the odds.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，这是在逆境中求生。

sentences.en: Childbirth is supposed to be this wonderful, beautiful, natural experience.
sentences.zh: 分娩本应是一种美妙、自然、美好的体验。

sentences.en: But for so many
sentences.zh: 但对许多

sentences.en: Black women and so many Black babies, it isn't.
sentences.zh: 黑人女性和许多黑人婴儿来说，并非如此。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: On Thursday, Israeli warplanes struck dozens of suspected Iranian military targets inside of Syria as tensions between Israel and Iran reached new heights.
sentences.zh: 周四，以色列战机袭击了叙利亚境内数十个疑似伊朗军事目标，以色列和伊朗之间的紧张局势达到了新的高度。

sentences.en: Israel said it was responding to an unsuccessful Iranian rocket attack involving 20 missiles launched
sentences.zh: 以色列表示，这是对伊朗一次未遂火箭弹袭击的回应，当时有20枚导弹从

sentences.en: from Syria, all of which were intercepted or fell short of their targets in Israeli-controlled territory.
sentences.zh: 叙利亚发射，所有导弹均被拦截或未击中以色列控制领土内的目标。

sentences.en: And they need to know that if it's going to be a disaster, then it's going to be a bull.
sentences.zh: 他们需要知道，如果这注定是一场灾难，那它就会是一场灾难。

sentences.en: During a presentation on Thursday, Israel's defense minister said that the airstrikes had destroyed all of Iran's military infrastructure in Syria.
sentences.zh: 在周四的发布会上，以色列国防部长表示，空袭摧毁了伊朗在叙利亚的所有军事基础设施。

sentences.en: If there is rain on our side, he said, there will be a flood on their side.
sentences.zh: 他说，如果他们那边下雨，我们这边就会发洪水。

sentences.en: The Times reports that Israel and Iran have been conducting a shadow war inside of Syria, under the cover of the Syrian civil war.
sentences.zh: 《泰晤士报》报道称，以色列和伊朗一直在叙利亚内战的掩护下，在叙利亚境内进行着一场影子战争。

sentences.en: But the conflict is now bursting into the open.
sentences.zh: 但这场冲突现在已经公开化了。

sentences.zh: 《每日新闻》（The Daily）由西奥·巴尔科姆（Theo Balcom）、琳赛·加里森（Lindsay Garrison）、雷切尔·奎斯特（Rachel Quester）、安妮·布朗（Annie Brown）、安迪·米尔斯（Andy Mills）制作，

sentences.en: Ike Sreeskanaraja, Claire Tennesketter, Paige Cowett, Michael Simon-Johnson, and Jessica Chung, with editing help from Larissa Anderson.
sentences.zh: 艾克·斯里坎纳拉贾（Ike Sreeskanaraja）、克莱尔·坦内斯凯特（Claire Tennesketter）、佩奇·考维特（Paige Cowett）、迈克尔·西蒙-约翰逊（Michael Simon-Johnson）和杰西卡·钟（Jessica Chung）参与制作，拉里萨·安德森（Larissa Anderson）提供编辑协助。

sentences.en: Lisa Tobin is our executive producer.
sentences.zh: 丽莎·托宾（Lisa Tobin）是我们的执行制片人。

sentences.en: Samantha Hennig is our editorial director.
sentences.zh: 萨曼莎·亨尼格（Samantha Hennig）是我们的编辑总监。

sentences.en: Our technical manager is Brad Fisher.
sentences.zh: 我们的技术经理是布拉德·费舍尔（Brad Fisher）。

sentences.en: And our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsverk of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格（Jim Brunberg）和本·兰兹维克（Ben Landsverk）创作。

sentences.en: Special thanks to Sam Dolnick, Michaela Bouchard, David Crackles, Stella Tan, and Talia Minsberg.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢萨姆·多尔尼克（Sam Dolnick）、米凯拉·布查德（Michaela Bouchard）、大卫·克拉克尔斯（David Crackles）、斯特拉·谭（Stella Tan）和塔利亚·明斯伯格（Talia Minsberg）。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗（Michael Barbaro）。

sentences.en: A reminder that tomorrow we'll bring you the fourth chapter of our new series,
sentences.zh: 提醒一下，明天我们将为您带来我们新系列节目的第四章，

sentences.en: Caliphate, right here on The Daily.
sentences.zh: 《哈里发》（Caliphate），就在《每日新闻》节目中。

sentences.en: See you Monday.
sentences.zh: 周一见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，该党一直处于一场残酷、混乱且有时令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》（Metro）节目中，我和莎拉·凯尼格（Sarah Koenig）将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在各大播客平台收听我们的节目。

sentences.en: Okay next time.
sentences.zh: 好吧，下次再说。

sentences.en: When you get your hands into Crystal Clarín.
sentences.zh: 当你接触到水晶克拉琳时。

sentences.en: Well, I will save your life.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我会救你一命。

sentences.en: Have you four main gig?
sentences.zh: 你们四个有主业吗？

sentences.en: That's all you decide to keep on that part of your
sentences.zh: 这就是你决定保留的那部分内容
